intro_ios: stashy is a native iOS and iPadOS client for your self-hosted Stash media server. It connects directly to your GraphQL endpoint and gives you a fast, polished interface for browsing, playing, and managing your library. Without any third-party tracking.
intro_mac: stashy is a native macOS client for your self-hosted Stash media server. It connects directly to your GraphQL endpoint and gives you a fast, polished interface for browsing, playing, and managing your library. Without any third-party tracking.
intro_tv: stashy is a native Apple TV client for your self-hosted Stash media server. It connects directly to your GraphQL endpoint and gives you a fast, focus-driven interface for browsing, playing, and managing your library on the big screen. Without any third-party tracking.
c_direct: Direct connection: Connect to your Stash server via GraphQL (Stash v0.26+).
c_direct_tv: Direct connection: Connect to your Stash server via GraphQL (Stash v0.26+), with optional custom HTTP headers per server.
c_library: Library browsing: Scenes, Performers, Studios, Galleries, Tags, Groups, and Markers.
c_library_tv: Library browsing: Scenes, Performers, Studios, Tags, Groups, Galleries, Images, and Markers.
c_search: Search & filters: Advanced filtering and sorting across all content types.
c_search_tv: Search & filters: Global search, saved Stash filters, and default sort and filter per library.
c_playback: Video playback: Built-in player with direct playback of your original files, subtitles, PiP, and resume support.
c_playback_tv: Video playback: Built-in player with direct play of original files (AV1, HEVC, high bitrate), scrubbing previews, subtitles, audio track selection, and resume support.
c_feeds: Feeds: Scroll through scenes, markers, clips, and images in a reels-style view.
c_keyboard_mac: Keyboard control: Play, seek, mute and page through Feeds with the keyboard.
c_home: Customizable home: Configure dashboard rows, tabs, and layout to match how you browse.
c_markers_tv: Markers: Marker cards on every scene page and a marker rail in the player.
c_ratings_tv: Ratings: Rate scenes and images from the remote.
c_previews_tv: Focus previews: Muted scene previews when a card stays focused.
c_multi: Multi-server: Save and switch between multiple Stash servers.
c_sync: Device sync: Support for Handy, Intiface, and LoveSpouse during playback.
c_pin_tv: PIN lock: Protect the app with a 4-digit PIN.
c_privacy: Privacy first: Direct communication with your server only. No analytics or third-party tracking.
plus_intro: stashy+ unlocks premium features with an optional subscription or one-time Lifetime purchase. Core browsing and playback stay free.
plus_intro_tv: stashy+ unlocks premium features with an optional subscription or one-time Lifetime purchase — one purchase covers iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. Core browsing and playback stay free.
h_included_tv: Included with stashy+ on Apple TV:
p_subs: AI Subs: On-device live captions and translation in the scene player (beta)
p_motion: AI Motion: Real-time video analysis to sync connected devices to on-screen motion (beta)
p_downloads: Downloads: Save scenes for offline viewing
p_mini: Mini player & watchlist: Keep watching while you browse, with Now Playing and a queue
p_verticals: Verticals: A dedicated feed for vertical videos
p_tools: Tools: Overview statistics, O-Count heatmap, Session Timeline, Charts, Performer Match, and RateMe
p_icons_ios: Custom app icons: Personalize stashy on your Home Screen
p_channels_tv: Channels: Start Feeds from a sort, saved filter, performer, studio, tag or group.
avail: Available as Monthly, Yearly, or Lifetime. Users who purchased stashy before 3.0 receive stashy+ Lifetime via Restore Purchases.
n_lang: stashy now speaks 12 languages, with a language picker in the app
n_foryou: For You (stashy+): scene recommendations on Home, built on your device and adjustable per performer, studio and tag
n_forgotten: Forgotten Favorites (stashy+): a Home row for favorites you have not played in a while
n_rows: Your own Home rows from a saved filter or a sort
n_dropdown: Home and Tools: sections as a dropdown in the top bar, Downloads and Watchlist buttons on the Dashboard
n_detail: Detail pages: section dropdown, sort and filter in the top bar
n_local: Optional local address per server, used automatically when it is reachable
n_landscape_ios: Scene page in landscape: player on the left, details in a column on the right
n_feeds_ios: Feeds: markers on the time bar, optional Add Marker button, double tap can jump between markers
n_feeds_mac: Feeds: markers on the time bar, optional Add Marker button
n_groups: Groups: sub-groups on the group page, all fields editable
n_tasks_ios: Server tasks like in the Stash web UI
n_feeds_tv: Feeds: rate scenes and count O's right from the overlay
n_lock_tv: The lock screen shows the moment the app leaves the foreground
